note: Independent re-judgment against RFC 2545 Section 3 ("The link-local address shall be included in the Next Hop field if and only if the BGP speaker shares a common subnet with the entity identified by the global IPv6 address carried in the Network Address of Next Hop field and the peer the route is being advertised to."). Tested: "only if the BGP speaker shares a common subnet with the entity identified by the global IPv6 address carried in the Network Address of Next Hop field and the peer the route is being advertised to." Gap: "The link-local address shall be included in the Next Hop field if". Producer: internal/component/bgp/reactor/link_scope.go::thirdPartyLinkLocal, with internal/component/bgp/reactor/link_scope.go::linkLocalNextHop. Re-read link_scope.go, rfc2545_peer_send_test.go, rfc2545_third_party_link_local_test.go, check_rfc.go::checkRFC2545NextHops, check_rfc2545_third_party.go::checkRFC2545ThirdPartyLinkLocal, check_rfc_predicate.go::requireRouteInstalledVia, rfc/discrimination/rfc2545/RFC2545-3-3.json, and all diffs since 1a8d24e0cb. link_scope.go changed only peerAddr.Unmap() -> peerAddr.Unmap().WithZone("") so scoped peer addresses compare cleanly against zone-free connected prefixes; thirdPartyLinkLocal still returns netip.Addr{} when the neighbor table has no entry, is unresolved, ambiguous, or unreadable, and routes are not re-advertised on late neighbor arrival, so the declared Gap stands. Test edits were fixture capability negotiation (negotiateForwardTestFamilies / ASN4), egressRouteFilter signature, owner-bound forwarding fixture migration, rs event declarations in test/plugin/rfc2545-joint-subnet.ci, and command constants in resolveThirdParty; assertions and expected bytes are unchanged. AC-7 judgment on checkRFC2545NextHops positive claim installation clause (assertion 5): strictly, the discrimination record citing assertion "4" (linkLocalNextHop mutant returning netip.Addr{}) does not independently observe assertion 5 failing, because assertion 4 precedes assertion 5 in the sequential checker and returns fail(4, ...) on the broken link-local before assertion 5 runs. However, the positive claim is NOT too wide and does not need narrowing through ze-test-judge: (1) checkRFC2545NextHops actually executes assertion 5 (requireRouteInstalledVia checking exact prefix, protocol bgp, selected, destSelected, installed, and active FIB nexthop matching linkLocal) on every green run, and requireRouteInstalledVia is independently unit-tested non-vacuous in check_oracle_contract_test.go and bgp_test.go; (2) RFC 2545 Section 3 binds the sender MP_REACH_NLRI Next Hop field, which assertion 4 and the linkLocalNextHop mutant directly discriminate; (3) no linkLocalNextHop break can reach assertion 5 past assertion 4 (same sequential pattern as checkRFC2545ThirdPartyLinkLocal, which also cites "4"). Verdict unchanged: partial with zero whole-requirement credit.
